scope: Full Power Stack daily refresh across US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia. GPACKET excluded. Canonical holdings ledger loaded first and every holding reviewed individually.
headlineRead: The market regime hardened overnight: Brent settled $97.92 and WTI $93.03 after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities, the US 10Y briefly reached ~4.805%, copper printed record highs near $14,728/t LME and $6.739/lb COMEX, and US equities weakened. The investable distinction is increasingly scarcity with cash flow versus scarcity already fully priced: refiners and copper producers have confirmed momentum, but entry discipline is now more important. Fertilizer also reaccelerated as Hormuz trade risk lifted CF and peers. AI physical infrastructure remains structurally strong but is no longer the freshest cross-asset driver today.
whatsNewNow: Middle East energy risk broadened beyond Hormuz: Houthi attacks damaged Saudi energy facilities; Brent settled $97.92 and WTI $93.03 on Sep 8.

Copper moved to fresh records: LME three-month copper reached about $14,728/t and COMEX September copper about $6.739/lb; FCX rose roughly 7% intraday, making the thesis stronger but the entry less attractive.
The US 10Y briefly moved above 4.8% as oil revived inflation concerns; S&P 500 fell 0.58%, Dow 1.18% and Nasdaq 0.32%, confirming negative cross-asset transmission rather than a commodity-only move.
Fertilizer re-entered the fresh-theme hierarchy as CF led fertilizer stocks higher on Hormuz/trade-flow concerns; this reinforces nitrogen scarcity but also worsens entry discipline after the rally.

Nuclear fuel security gained fresh geopolitical relevance: new analysis warns Russian-linked uranium supply influence could rise materially by 2040 while Saudi Arabia prepares enhanced IAEA monitoring under its US civil-nuclear framework.
TradingView Top Stories clustered around oil/inflation/Fed risk, yen/BOJ tightening, Tesla Cybercab regulation, Nvidia/open AI and selective AI software. These were discovery inputs only.
Official August ISM remains authoritative and unchanged: Manufacturing 54.6 and Services 55.4; no timestamp-only churn warranted.

ESS end-demand versus battery manufacturing overcapacity
Gold hedge versus high real yields

developingThemes.name: Middle East Oil / Refined Products / Shipping Risk
developingThemes.whyNow: Houthi attacks on Saudi energy facilities broadened the supply-risk map while Brent settled $97.92 and WTI $93.03.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Crude, diesel/gasoline, refinery margins, freight, inflation, yields, consumer purchasing power and tanker economics.
developingThemes.confirmation: Further infrastructure/shipping disruption, strong cracks and inventory draws.
developingThemes.invalidation: Durable de-escalation plus normalised shipping and product spreads.
developingThemes.nextTest: EIA, PPI/CPI, Saudi/Iran/Hormuz developments and product cracks.
developingThemes.action: Own quality cash flow; refiners are confirming but increasingly crowded, so avoid chasing gaps.

developingThemes.name: Higher-for-Longer / Fed-Hike / Weak-End Credit Stress
developingThemes.whyNow: 10Y briefly exceeded 4.8% as oil/inflation risk hit bonds; equity breadth weakened ahead of inflation data.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Raises hurdle rates for data centres, utilities, housing, software and pre-commercial robotics; rewards FCF and strong balance sheets.
developingThemes.confirmation: Hot PPI/CPI, 10Y/30Y new highs or further CCC widening.
developingThemes.invalidation: Clean disinflation with sustained yield/spread compression.
developingThemes.nextTest: PPI Sep 10, CPI Sep 11 and FOMC Sep 15-16.
developingThemes.action: Require cash conversion and financing visibility.

developingThemes.name: Copper Scarcity / Tariff Distortion / Grid Demand
developingThemes.whyNow: LME and COMEX copper printed records as mine output weakness, US tariff uncertainty and AI/grid demand converged.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Direct producer earnings leverage plus higher input costs for electrical equipment, wire/cable and construction.
developingThemes.confirmation: Physical premiums/ex-US inventory draws and sustained prices above breakout levels.
developingThemes.invalidation: Inventory rebuild plus weaker China/industrial demand or tariff unwind.
developingThemes.nextTest: LME/COMEX/SHFE inventories, US refined-copper tariff decision and China demand.
developingThemes.action: FCX thesis upgraded tactically but do not chase after the ~7% Sep 8 surge; preferred entry now requires pullback/retest.

developingThemes.name: AI Power / Grid / Time-to-Power + Funded Demand
developingThemes.whyNow: ISM shortages and AI-server demand remain strong, but copper/input inflation and higher yields increase project underwriting pressure.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Supports electrical equipment, transmission, cooling, onsite generation and automation while penalising unfunded load queues.
developingThemes.confirmation: Named backlog, deposits, customer funding, order growth and FCF.
developingThemes.invalidation: Cancellations, weak utilisation or financing failures.
developingThemes.nextTest: Supplier orders, hyperscaler capex and YTL contracted utilisation.
developingThemes.action: Prefer funded backlog and pricing power; input-cost pass-through now matters more.

developingThemes.name: Fertilizer / Nitrogen Trade-Flow Risk vs Farm Affordability
developingThemes.whyNow: CF led fertilizer stocks higher as Hormuz disruption raised concern around global fertilizer/feedstock trade flows.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Supports nitrogen pricing and CF/NTR earnings but worsens farmer input economics; premium seed is less deferable than machinery/irrigation.
developingThemes.confirmation: Firm ammonia/urea pricing, constrained exports and healthy crop/input ratios.
developingThemes.invalidation: Trade flows normalise while farm margins weaken enough to force application cuts.
developingThemes.nextTest: Fertilizer export flows, natural gas/feedstock, crop/input ratios and company guidance.
developingThemes.action: CF thesis strengthened but rally worsens entry; CTVA/BG remain quality, AGCO second-stage only.

developingThemes.name: LNG Diversification / Energy-Security Rerouting
developingThemes.whyNow: Broader Gulf infrastructure risk reinforces non-Hormuz LNG and alternative export-route value; Papua LNG remains a concrete XOM catalyst.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Supports contracted LNG, terminals, storage and alternative corridors more reliably than pure spot-price beta.
developingThemes.confirmation: Papua LNG FID, high LNG utilisation and rerouting investment.
developingThemes.invalidation: Durable Gulf normalisation and weaker LNG contracting.
developingThemes.nextTest: Papua LNG Q4 FID and LNG utilisation/offtake.
developingThemes.action: XOM/LNG quality exposure; DIALOG research remains differentiated Malaysia infrastructure watch.

developingThemes.name: Uranium / Nuclear Fuel Security
developingThemes.whyNow: Fresh concern over future Russian-linked uranium influence reinforces Western fuel-cycle security; Saudi civil-nuclear safeguards progress broadens reactor/fuel demand optionality.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Supports proven uranium, conversion/enrichment and nuclear-component suppliers over speculative reactor concepts.
developingThemes.confirmation: Long-term utility contracts, Western conversion/enrichment investment and new reactor commitments.
developingThemes.nextTest: Utility contracting, Cameco/Westinghouse execution and Saudi project awards.
developingThemes.action: CCJ remains preferred fuel-cycle exposure; CW/BWXT remain quality nuclear picks but valuation discipline applies.

developingThemes.name: ESS Demand vs Battery Manufacturing Overcapacity
developingThemes.whyNow: China's pause on new storage-battery factory approvals remains a strong quality filter despite robust ESS deployment.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Supports deployment/integration while pressuring commodity cell capacity and speculative lithium economics.
developingThemes.confirmation: Capacity rationalisation while deployments remain strong.
developingThemes.invalidation: Rapid approval restart with healthy utilisation/margins.
developingThemes.nextTest: China policy details, cell pricing/utilisation and ESS deployments.
developingThemes.action: Prefer integration/end demand; avoid undifferentiated cell/lithium capacity.

developingThemes.name: Selective AI Software / Cyber / Physical Automation
developingThemes.whyNow: AI monetisation remains selective, but commodity/rate shocks dominate current cross-asset pricing.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Rewards ARR/RPO/FCF and real deployment ROI; compresses narrative-only multiples.
developingThemes.action: Pullback-only. Robotics adoption order unchanged: fixed/warehouse > cobots/mobile > industrial humanoids > general-purpose.

developingThemes.name: Gold / Fiscal-Monetary Hedge
developingThemes.whyNow: Geopolitical support persists but rising yields have again pressured bullion.
developingThemes.marketTransmission: Safe-haven/fiscal hedge versus real-yield and USD opportunity cost.
developingThemes.confirmation: Gold holds despite high real yields or yields fall.
developingThemes.invalidation: Persistent real-yield/USD rise with bullion breakdown.
